text_cases.instruction: Evaluate the purchase request against the policy and produce exactly six lines in this order: Decision, Total, Cheaper quote, Justification, Blocker, Next. Use only facts present in the request. Decision must be APPROVE, DENY, or CONDITIONAL. Calculate the selected total yourself. Output no introduction or closing.
text_cases.input:
Procurement policy:
1. A software purchase may be approved only when the selected total does not exceed $12,000 and at least two comparable quotes are recorded.
2. A team may select a more expensive supplier only when a concrete business justification is documented.
3. A cloud service that processes customer data cannot start until the data-processing agreement (DPA) is signed. A planned date or verbal promise is not a signed DPA.

Purchase request:
- Requested service: hosted design-review workspace for 24 staff members.
- Selected supplier: North Cloud at $420 per seat for the full term. North Cloud includes required single sign-on integration.
- Second quote: East Systems at $410 per seat for the same term. East Systems does not include the required single sign-on integration.
- The team documented single sign-on as the reason for selecting North Cloud.
- The DPA is still pending legal review; nobody has reported it signed.
- Desired service start: 2026-10-01.
- Budget owner confirmed that taxes are handled under a separate existing agreement and must not be added to this comparison.
text_cases.reference:
Decision: CONDITIONAL
Total: $10,080
Cheaper quote: East Systems — $9,840
Justification: North Cloud includes required single sign-on integration
Blocker: DPA is not signed
Next: Sign the DPA before service starts on 2026-10-01
rubric: Calculates 24 × $420 as the selected $10,080 total
Calculates East Systems' 24 × $410 quote as $9,840
Recognizes that two quotes and the price-difference justification are present
Treats the unsigned DPA as a blocker rather than assuming approval
Keeps the desired start date conditional on signing the DPA first
Does not add taxes, legal approval, dates, or exceptions absent from the request
Produces exactly the six requested labeled lines
